mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding_securities (account_id, security_id, quantity, locked_quantity, average_price) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{securityId}, #{quantity}, #{lockedQuantity}, #{averagePrice})
mapper.update: UPDATE holding_securities SET quantity = #{quantity}, average_price = #{averagePrice}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE holding_security_id = #{holdingSecurityId}
UPDATE holding_securities SET quantity = quantity - #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE holding_security_id = #{holdingSecurityId}
UPDATE holding_securities SET locked_quantity = locked_quantity + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE holding_security_id = #{holdingSecurityId}
UPDATE holding_securities SET locked_quantity = locked_quantity - #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE holding_security_id = #{holdingSecurityId}
mapper.select: SELECT holding_security_id, account_id, security_id, quantity, locked_quantity, average_price FROM holding_securities WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
